tools.name: agency_info
tools.description: Who Aster National Insurance Group is: licence, the lines and states it writes, how to reach it and its hours. Call this first.

tools.name: check_appetite
tools.description: Whether Aster National Insurance Group writes a given line of insurance in a given US state.

tools.name: start_online_quote
tools.description: The link where the client starts a quote with Aster National Insurance Group on the agency's own quoting platform.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a quote request to Aster National Insurance Group's licensed staff. Ask the person for their name, an email or phone, the line, the state and what they need covered, and get their OK before calling. A licensed agent replies; this is not a bound policy and no price is promised.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_quote" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Send a quote request to Aster National Insurance Group's licensed staff. Ask the person for their name, an email or phone, the line, the state and what they nee…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "aster-national-insurance" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
